cases.answer_excerpt:
Having completed ACIT 1515, you meet the prerequisite for several BCIT courses in the Computer Information Technology program. 

The courses that list ACIT 1515 as a prerequisite include:

* **ACIT 2515 (Object Oriented Programming)**: Requires a minimum grade of 50% in ACIT 1515 (or 60% in COMP 1516).

cases.question: which course can I learn how to use terraform?
cases.standalone_question: Which BCIT course teaches how to use Terraform?
cases.answer_excerpt:
You can learn how to use Terraform in several courses at BCIT, including COMP 4964 (DevOps Engineering) and ACIT 4640.

* **COMP 4964 (DevOps Engineering):** Covers Terraform and Ansible in its curriculum during the November 17 week, alongside other cloud and DevOps tools like AWS CloudFormation, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* **ACIT 4640:** Features dedicated weeks introducing Terraform syntax, commands, modules, variables, and using Terraform to deploy images created with Packer.
* **Computer Systems Technology (CST) Diploma - Cloud Computing Option:** Covers infrastructure and DevOps tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, and Docker as part of its hands-on project-based curriculum.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/outlines/20253043982/
- https://www.bcit.ca/outlines/20261089230/
- https://www.bcit.ca/programs/computer-systems-technology-diploma-full-time-5500dipma/
